book.voidiscoming.page.1:
VOID IS COMING

Welcome to Void Is Coming!

This book explains the main features of the mod.
book.voidiscoming.page.2:
VOID GRASS

Void Grass is found in Void Plains.

Void Sheep can eat it and restore their wool.
book.voidiscoming.page.3:
VOID CREATURES

Void Pig — 20 HP, 4 DMG, speed 0.3.

Void Cow — 30 HP, 5 DMG, speed 0.4.
book.voidiscoming.page.4:
VOID SHEEP

27 HP, 4.5 DMG, speed 0.25.

It can attack players and has a special cloning ability.
book.voidiscoming.page.5:
SHEEP CLONE

A Void Sheep can clone itself every 2 minutes.

It needs wool and a target.

The original loses its wool. The clone starts sheared.
book.voidiscoming.page.6:
VOID ESSENCE

Void Essence can rarely drop from Void creatures.

The Stone Golem guarantees Void Essence.

It is also needed to craft magical staffs.
book.voidiscoming.page.7:
MAGICAL STAFFS

Wooden — 1 DMG
Iron — 3 DMG
Diamond — 6 DMG
Netherite — 9 DMG

Void Essence is needed for crafting.
book.voidiscoming.page.8:
POTIONS

Small Mana Potion — 4 mana
Medium Mana Potion — 8 mana
Large Mana Potion — 12 mana

Heal Potion restores health.
book.voidiscoming.page.9:
BOTTLES

Empty Small Bottle

Big Empty Bottle

Both have a maximum stack size of 16.
book.voidiscoming.page.10:
SKILL TREE

Spend Skill Points to unlock skills.

There are different paths, bonuses and spells.

Skills have different costs and requirements.
book.voidiscoming.page.11:
SPELLS

Unlocked spells can be equipped.

Use Equip and Unequip to manage them.

There are limited spell slots.
book.voidiscoming.page.12:
SKILL PATHS

Warrior — armor and sword power.

Archer — health, speed and bow power.

Mage — mana, affinity and wand power.
book.voidiscoming.page.13:
STONE GOLEM

HP: 200
DMG: 15
Speed: 0.22
Knockback Resistance: 1.0
Follow Range: 32

The Stone Golem does not despawn.
book.voidiscoming.page.14:
GOLEM ATTACKS

The Stone Golem uses melee attacks.

It can throw Stone Projectiles.

It can also use Ground Slam.
book.voidiscoming.page.15:
GOLEM REWARD

Defeating the Stone Golem gives a Stone Golem Core and Void Essence.

Explore the Void and discover its secrets.
